title.zh: 获取存储空间的加密规则
title.en: Retrieve the encryption rules of a bucket

descriptions.zh: 只有Bucket的拥有者及授权的RAM用户才能获取Bucket的加密规则，否则返回403错误。有关Bucket加密的更多信息，请参见**[服务器端加密](~~31871~~)**。
descriptions.en: Only the bucket owner and authorized Resource Access Management (RAM) users can retrieve the encryption rules of a bucket. Otherwise, a 403 error is returned. For more information about bucket encryption, see **[Server-side encryption](~~31871~~)**.
